$comment: Open-data sources for the content pipeline (scripts/content). Every licence here was read from the source itself before use; see DECISIONS.md, section 'Open data'. Raw files are downloaded to content-raw/ (git-ignored). Hashes of the exact files used are pinned in sources.lock.json.

sources.name: SCOWL (Spell Checker Oriented Word Lists)
sources.author: Kevin Atkinson and contributors
sources.license: SCOWL licence (permissive, MIT-like) with public-domain and BSD/WordNet components
obligations: Keep the SCOWL copyright and permission notice in all copies and in supporting documentation.
Keep the Ispell (BSD) and WordNet 1.6 notices that SCOWL includes.
Use sizes up to 60 only; the UK Advanced Cryptics Dictionary terms apply above size 80, and the Australian 'D' spellings carry an extra notice.
sources.use: Commonness tiers (size levels), American/British variants, inflection families, proper names and abbreviations to exclude. The spell checker itself reuses dictionary-en, which is SCOWL size 60 en-US.

sources.name: VarCon (Variant Conversion Info)
sources.author: Kevin Atkinson and Benjamin Titze; word lists from Ispell (Geoff Kuenning)
sources.license: VarCon licence (permissive, MIT-like) plus Ispell BSD-style licence
obligations: Keep the Kevin Atkinson and Benjamin Titze copyright and permission notices in supporting documentation.
Reproduce the Ispell copyright, conditions and disclaimer in the documentation.
Mark the derived data as modified (Ispell clause 3): only American/British pairs are extracted.
sources.use: American and British spelling pairs (color/colour, center/centre). Only the A and B tags are used; Australian and Canadian data is ignored.

sources.name: dictionary-en (Hunspell en-US from SCOWL)
sources.author: Titus Wormer (packaging); Kevin Atkinson (SCOWL)
obligations: Keep the licence file with the copied dictionary (public/dict/LICENSE-dictionary-en.txt).
sources.use: The full spell-check dictionary in the browser (already a dependency since phase F), the validity filter for game words, and the NOSUGGEST taboo flags.

sources.name: Tatoeba sentences
sources.author: The Tatoeba community (each sentence's author is credited)
sources.license: CC BY 2.0 FR (part of the corpus is also CC0 1.0)
obligations: Name the author of every sentence used and link to the sentence.
Name the licence with a link.
Say that the sentences were changed (filtered and normalised).
sources.use: English sentences for dictation and examples, Arabic translations as optional hints, English token frequencies for word ranking, quality signals (reviews, native speakers).

sources.name: CMU Pronouncing Dictionary
sources.author: Carnegie Mellon University
obligations: Reproduce the CMU copyright notice, conditions and disclaimer in the documentation (the credits page).
sources.use: Homophone detection (same pronunciation, different spelling) and silent-letter hints. Pronunciations are not shipped.

sources.name: Original content written for this project
sources.author: Kitaba
sources.use: The hand-written word bank (ids, levels, Arabic hints, examples), the reviewed Arabic hints, original sentences, scenarios and messages, blocklists.
